title: Derived invariants under an equivalence compute homogeneous continuous cohomology
statement: Let $G$ be a compact Hausdorff totally disconnected topological group, and $\mathcal A$ an abelian category [def-sp-abelian] with injective resolutions [def-sp-injective-resolutions]. Let $E:\mathcal A\simeq\operatorname{DiscreteRep}_{\mathbf Z}(G)$ be an equivalence to integer representations whose elements have open stabilizers [def-exc-discrete-modules-category], with representation universe $\max(u,s)$, at least the group universe $u$ so that continuous coinduction stays in this category. Let $\Gamma:\mathcal A\to\mathrm{Ab}_{\max(u,s)}$ be additive and equipped with a natural isomorphism $\Gamma\simeq(F\mapsto E(F)^G)$, whose maps are restrictions of equivariant coefficient maps. For $F\in\mathcal A$, let $N$ be a topological integer representation with discrete coefficient topology in universe $\max(u,t)$, and let $e:E(F)\simeq_{\mathbf Z}N$ be an equivariant linear equivalence. Then for every $q\geq0$ there is a type equivalence $(R^q\Gamma)(F)\simeq H^q_{\mathrm{cont}}(G,N)$ [def-sp-left-exact-additive], where the right side is homology of the homogeneous continuous cochain complex: its degree $n$ consists of $G$-invariants in $n+1$ iterated continuous maps $G\to\cdots\to N$, with alternating omission differential. This allows different coefficient universes and imposes no finiteness on the ring of integers or on the module.

source.place: Section 0DVG, section-continuous-group-cohomology, profinite comparison; explicit homogeneous change of variables

proof.text: Choose an injective resolution I of F. Define V to be the invariants functor after E, and deduce V.Additive from eta via Functor.additive_of_iso. InjectiveResolution.isoRightDerivedObj computes derived Gamma using Gamma(I). NatIso.mapHomologicalComplex eta identifies Gamma(I) with V(I); apply the homology functor to this complex isomorphism and take its underlying additive equivalence.

Give the underlying module E(F) the discrete topology and construct its continuous representation M directly, by viewing each action linear map as a continuous linear map. Apply the invariant-resolution comparison to M with the identity coefficient equivalence. This identifies H^q(V(I)) with continuous cohomology of M in the same universe.
Apply the proved coefficient-equivalence theorem to the given equivariant linear equivalence e from M to N. Compose the three type equivalences to obtain the original conclusion.

proof_origin.place: Section 0DVG; P3 formalizes resolution/natural-isomorphism transport and proves the cross-universe homogeneous coefficient transport; the same-universe profinite resolution comparison is a separate named theorem.
